name: SINBON Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: SINBON Electronics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells computer peripherals, connectors, wires, and other parts in Mainland China, Hong Kong, the United States, Taiwan, and internationally. The company operates through Green Energy, Industrial Application, Medical Health, Automotive & Aviation, and Communication segments. The Green Energy segment develops, manufactures, and sells cable assembly and control modules for green energy industries, such as solar photovoltaic, wind power and offshore wind power.
